content: अकथित {%a.%} ‘Not told’, not otherwise mentioned by way of any of the other case-relations, such as अपादान <ab>&c.</ab>; a name given to the indirect (गौण) object governed by verbs like दुह्, याच् <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>cf.</ab> अनभिहितम् अकथितं कर्म and ‘अकथितं च’ <ls>P. I. 4. 51</ls>. In the sentence ‘गां पयः दोग्धि’ गाम् is the indirect (गौण) object, and it could have taken the ablative ending.
